newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Pepsi-Gemex begun as accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pepsi-Gemex begun as accumulate.

text.p: Santander Investment said on Tuesday it began coverage of Mexican bottler Pepsi-Gemex with an accumulate recommendation, the brokerage said in a statement.
"For 1997 and 1998 we expect Gemex's sales to grow by 8.7 percent and 10.8 percent in real terms," analysts said in a report.
They estimated Pepsi-Gemex's net profits would fall 18 percent in real terms in 1997 because of exchange rate losses, and grow 46.9 percent in real terms in 1998.
The bottler's shares were down 0.12 peso to 15.90 pesos in late trading on Tuesday.
